nom: Exuviance HydraPrep pH Skin Balancing Face Toner

avis.titre: Excellent results on my combo skin!
avis.texte: I have used this toner years ago and found it to work great during a hormonal skin issue. So glad to have this product again!! I have tried several other new exfoliating toners but stinging and drying occurred with oiliness after time. This never seems to happen with this one!
I have tried numerous glycolic toners before but this one is by far the best. it is hydrating and exfoliating. it balances my skin out!
Feel your pores pleasantly tingling as your face gets toned up and refreshed!
This toner contains harmful and unnecessary blue and yellow dyes in it. I do not recommend this product.
I've been using another brand for several years and I did not think I would find something comparable. This is actually much better and more reasonably priced.

The associate who sold this to me said it was close to what I normally use. Within four days it had stripped my skin of all my natural oils and made me break out worse than I've EVER had. Returned quickly. Had to see had a dermatologist fix the mess.

This toner just completes my skin routine. It feels like it just sinks into my skin prepping it for my serum and Citrafirm oil. I recently tried the Indie Lee toner and it broke me out, Clinique dries me out and others make me super oily.

This stuff is gentle and leaves my skin so smooth. Now I can use this 2-3 days in a row but will need a one day break but it doesn't like burn it or anything. This is still the most gentle toner I've been able to find that doesn't strip it or dry it out.
While it does a decent job at hydrating, there is overwhelming fragrance and if you have sensitive skin it will burn/irritate the skin.

This toner is not irritating to my skin at all. It feels really gentle, yet I can tell that it has been keeping my skin clear, smooth and with a healthy glow. After 2 weeks of consistent use, my skin complexion looks brighter and the texture is smoother.
This toner is light Weight and absorbs quickly. Love this stuff!
This toner restores the pH balance. It makes my skin brighter and more radiant. This toner is part of my AM skincare.
I like this toner and make sure to use it after I wash my face daily.

avis.titre: Quality Products that do what they promise!
avis.texte: Exuviance has changed my belief in high quality skin care products because I've seen such a dramatic improvement. It's amazing and I feel good about my skin for the first time in 20 years!
I have mature skin with slight rosacea. After cleansing I always use this Exuvience toner. Softer, brighter and cleaner face!! Balanced ph with needed acids. Love this stuff!
34 years old, still break out from time to time but I also get dried out for most acne toners. This is the best toner I have ever used!!! It's a 10 out of 10

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over again!
avis.texte: What can I say, this product is awesome,a permanent buyer of this!!!!
My skin craves it when I don't use it and feels incredible when I do!!

avis.titre: I would buy this again and again!
avis.texte: I was a little hesitant at first about purchasing this because the thought of getting older is so daunting, but I knew I had to start somewhere, and I'm glad I did! This is a game changer! This really makes my skin looks so refreshed and new!

This toner is effective. I like the slight tingle from the acids, and my skin feels prepped, toned and clean after using it. My only complaint is while I do love the scent, I don't like artificial perfume in my skincare.
this toner took my skin to another level! as a matter of fact this is my third skin product from exuviance and i am very pleased.
Over the years I've had a hard time finding a good toner for my skin. With help from the people who work at Ulta referring this brand I'm completely amazed on how great my skin is using it!!!

I went to Ulta in search of a new Toner because I was using one that contained witch hazel which isn't good for the skin. I told a cashier I was looking for a quality toner than I could use on my skin. At the time I thought I had dry skin but she informed me that my skin looked like combination skin. After being skeptical, I bought the product. I have to say it smells very good. Almost like cucumbers. It does work very well for clearing your pores. Especially the ones on my nose. The only reason I give 4 stars is because I am unable to use this everyday. It breaks me out, so I only use it at night, every other night. If you have the financial state to buy a morning and night toner I would certainly buy this and use it for night usage! overall, I was very happy with my purchase and will continue buying for my nightly routine!

If you're looking for a simple toner to add to your collection this one is GREAT. I hesitate to say moisturizing because that's not what timers are meant for. I will say this does wonders for balancing out my skin and my face is definitely not oily throughout the day. It doesn't make my face feel tight but cleansed and refreshed!!
Love how it makes my skin feel. Very light scent. Can be a bit drying.
I really love how this toner makes my face feel, not too harsh!
Absolute favorite toner! Doesn't strip your skin or leave behind a sticky residue.

avis.titre: I have been but most definitely
avis.texte: I have been using this product for about 6 years now( and 2 repackaging changes later). I walked into an Ulta Beauty in Florida and asked the Rep for something to keep my skin balanced and not stripped but clean and comfortable, balancing out my combination skin. She brought me the Exurviance Moisture Balancing toner, I was skeptical but it worked for my skin and helped with my pores, they were clean and my skin felt refreshed. This toner doesn't have an overwhelming fragrance either. I have kept this in my arsenal because my skin loves it. I have been through a lot of trials with toners but this one remains my main squeeze, my go to, my old faithful.
Feels great on my skin after using the cleanser. Nice clean tingly feeling.

avis.titre: This helped leave my face so nice & moisturized!
avis.texte: Left my face so soft. Also cleared my face of any dark spots! Definitely recommend!
Best toner I've ever used! My skin always feel clean and never dries it out. Highly recommend!
I started using w/other Exuvience product. I love it! Completely changed my complexion.
Don't want to be over dramatic, but all I needed was one night of use and it worked. My skin was peeling and had some bumps and I swear they are gone my skin has never looked better.

I had been struggling with finding a better toner since the one I was using left my face dry. I came upon another high end brand and it didn't work for me at all, but then I came across this! I have normal to dry skin and this removed what was left of my makeup after washing my face so good! It left my face feeling moisturized and clean, has a light scent but not too much that it's irritating. It minimizes my pores and doesn't dry my skin at all! I love it, I'm definitely going to keep buying when I'm done with this one!!

avis.titre: Holy Grail for middle-aged combination skin
avis.texte: Seriously, just try it. Combine it with the AHA cleanser for the perfect skin care regimen.

I bought this a month ago and can definitely see difference in my skin. My dark spots are a little lighter and I am getting less breakouts. This toner does not sting and is gentle on my sensitive skin. If anything it is a tad sticky but I feel like that helps the skin absorb serum or moisturizer you put on after.

avis.titre: Gentle tone, removed make up and minimizes pores. I love it!
avis.texte: I use this daily after I remove my makeup! Skin looks and feels great!

After washing my face, I apply the toner with makeup remover pads. It has helped my skin texture so much! It has made my skin more supple and smooth and has made the pores on my face invisible--except for the ones on my nose, but it has helped. I've converted a lot of friends and family to this product because it really is that good!

I have had bad luck with toners in the past since my skin is so sensitive, but this toner is so gentle! Not to mention it makes my skin feel super soft. I've only been using this product for a week, along with the exuviance clarifying cleanser, but I have seen a drastic change in my skin. I am prone to adult acne breakouts and it definitely helped clear that right up.

This toner is my ride or die! It had kept my skin balanced to keep my skin normal. I will never put another toner on my face. This brand in general puts any other skin care brand to shame. Everything is amazing! I also use their oxygen facial, mud mask, clarifying cleanser, sleep mask and a few more. Needless to say, IM ADDICTED!
I use this product right after cleansing my face, it is good but can be a little strong too!
This toner is a great gentle exfoliator and leaves my skin feeling clean and prepared for the rest of my skincare routine. I'm obsessed!
Really works to balance tones on skin and removes blemishes. I notice a lot of spots going away in my face within a wk of using it.

avis.titre: Love this toner and it smells great!!
avis.texte: Exuviance Rep was very knowledgeable about the products. Great attitude and funny personality!
Have liked everything else I've used but this toner made my face even more oily than it already is. I took it back to the store to exchange it.
Causes slight peeling ... for acne prone skin it will get worse before getting better
Exuvance products have made a huge difference in my 60 year old skin.

This is such a great step in my cleansing routine. This toner removes any excess oil/makeup that's left on the skin after cleansing. It has a refreshing scent and doesn't dry out my skin like most toners do. I always say that if their prices weren't so steep, I would be able to afford this more often and not be so frugal with the product. The quality though is worth it all.
I've used Lancôme for years, and didn't think there would be anything out there that could compare. I was wrong. This is THEE BEST product I've used thus far!
I've been using this product for 10 years and love it! Great product!!!
I have combination oily skin. This with the new cleanser works wonders!
